usage.callShape: POST https://x402.telnyx.com/v1/chat/completions with OpenAI-compatible JSON body {model, messages[]} — model MUST be "moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6" (NOT "kimi-k2")
quirks: The registry/service id 'kimi-k2' is NOT a valid model param. Sending model:'kimi-k2' returns HTTP 400 'model kimi-k2 not supported' BEFORE payment (no money lost). Use model:'moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6' (standard) or 'moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6-long' (long context).

The 400 error body conveniently lists all supported models: ['MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.7','moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6','zai-org/GLM-5.1-FP8','moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6-long'] — this endpoint is a shared multi-model gateway, not Kimi-only.
Observed cost was $0.02 USDC on Base, not the registry surface price of $0.0010 — price likely scales with tokens; budget ~$0.02 per small call.
x402-only auth; pre-flight on a wrong model 400s before charging, so model validation is free to probe.
usage.guide: POST to https://x402.telnyx.com/v1/chat/completions with an OpenAI-style JSON body. You MUST set model to "moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6" — the registry's "kimi-k2" id is rejected with a 400 before any payment is taken. Pass messages as an array of {role, content} objects; payment is via x402 (USDC on Base, ~$0.02 per small call). Read the assistant reply from body.choices[0].message.content and token usage from body.usage.
